mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.target_type, h.target_id, h.path, h.component, h.priority, h.status, CASE h.target_type WHEN 1 THEN u.username WHEN 2 THEN r.role_name WHEN 3 THEN d.dept_name END AS target_name FROM sys_home_page h LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON h.target_type = 1 AND h.target_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON h.target_type = 2 AND h.target_id = r.id AND r.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON h.target_type = 3 AND h.target_id = d.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.target_type = #{query.targetType} AND h.status = #{query.status} ORDER BY h.target_type, h.priority, h.id

SELECT h.path, h.component, m.id AS menu_id FROM sys_home_page h LEFT JOIN sys_permission m ON m.path IN (h.path, SUBSTRING(h.path, 2)) AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 0 AND (h.menu_id IS NULL OR h.menu_id = m.id) AND (m.id IS NULL OR (m.menu_type = 2 AND m.status = 0)) AND ((h.target_type = 1 AND h.target_id = #{userId})
OR (h.target_type = 2 AND h.target_id IN #{roleId})
OR (h.target_type = 3 AND h.target_id = #{departmentId}) OR (h.target_type = 4 AND h.target_id = 0)) ORDER BY h.target_type, h.priority, h.id
